fixture_harness.cause: The disposable TCP fixture omitted a socket error handler. Readiness probes closed sockets and ECONNRESET could terminate the fixture before fault injection.
fixture_harness.correction: Handle connection-reset errors and assert that the exact host, child and descendant are live immediately before injection.
fixture_harness.corrected_fixture_suite: The complete release suite is recorded in validation-v0.13.json.

node_restart_assertion.cause: Gateway delivery cleanup can set CANCELLING before node-epoch reconciliation. Reconciliation then records CANCELLED with execution_interrupted; the earlier test incorrectly required one race-dependent label.
node_restart_assertion.correction: Require INTERRUPTED or CANCELLED plus execution_interrupted, an advanced node epoch, zero charge, REFUNDED billing, no physical claim and no receipt from the terminated node. No accounting or gateway rule was weakened.

windows_stop_observation.cause: CIM briefly returned a dying process row with a null command line after an earlier positive process observation.
windows_stop_observation.correction: Bounded retries require readable program, command and creation identity. A gone process is recognized; a persistently unreadable live process keeps its registry entry and refuses unsafe adoption or termination.
windows_stop_observation.recovery: The tracked partial shutdown resumed and completed before the next build and restart.

registry_namespace_review.cause: A session-local Windows mutex gives separate logon sessions different locks for the same registry path.
registry_namespace_review.correction: The native helper selects the global namespace and the JavaScript caller requires a matching namespace acknowledgement. The installed prototype pin was preserved in a private backup and explicitly replaced while every managed service was stopped.
registry_namespace_review.scope: Global namespace selection and same-session contention/owner-loss fixtures are checked. Actual multiple Windows logon sessions remain unmeasured.

direct_cli_start.observed_after: Core services and the original CPU route were ready; the mixed route had not started.
direct_cli_start.cause: The direct lab entry point awaited start at module scope. Starting installed device recipes dynamically imported a module that imports lab lifecycle helpers, leaving a circular unresolved top-level await.
direct_cli_start.correction: The entry point finishes module evaluation and handles the asynchronous command rejection explicitly. A subsequent direct start reuses live owned services and proceeds with the remaining recipe.
direct_cli_start.scope: Earlier exported-function upgrade harnesses did not exercise this direct CLI entry path.

outbox_fault_coverage.cause: The short response settled before the coordinator outage reached receipt delivery. A fixed restart delay did not prove that the outbox was exercised.
outbox_fault_coverage.correction: Observe the current service boot before requesting inference, submit its boot-bound stop without delayed process inspection, and keep the coordinator unavailable until a matching completed receipt is observed on disk. Bound receipt waiting, require receipt_pending in the completed stream, restore the coordinator, then require one terminal settlement and removal of the accepted outbox file.
outbox_fault_coverage.scope: The failed attempt is not credited as receipt-outage proof; it did not show a lost receipt or duplicate charge.

pending_stream_observation.correction: The test now permits seven seconds after persistence for the node to finish its existing five-second receipt request and emit receipt_pending. This changes an acceptance observation bound, not the node timeout or settlement contract.
pending_stream_observation.recovery: The finally block restored the coordinator after the failed observation.

browser_login_coverage.observation: The two journeys remained at the login form with a rate-limit/error alert after a rapid sequence of real logins.
browser_login_coverage.correction: A shared browser helper requires HTTP 201 or an explicit HTTP 429, honors Retry-After when forwarded, otherwise waits a bounded full limit window, and extends only the test deadline. It clears entered passwords from failed-login DOM state before diagnostics.
browser_login_coverage.scope: The full corrected browser run and its distinct counts are recorded separately; the first nine passes are not added again.

boundary: Initial harness, module-discovery, process-observation, namespace and transport shutdown failures remain recorded. Local corrections and CI checks do not establish public or independent-host model readiness.

windows_ci_startup.observation: Windows PowerShell process-identity queries exceeded the unchanged 5000ms limit under the filtered service environment, before service readiness. Original fixtures discarded the startup stderr; the diagnostic change preserved it.
windows_ci_startup.intermediate_attempt: Explicit system-module imports and a populated system-only module search path passed locally but did not fix hosted Windows. The third run passed five of fourteen Windows cases; this attempt is not credited as a CI fix.
windows_ci_startup.diagnosis: The measured stall is tied to module discovery during system-module import. Both an inherited module path and an empty search path completed the controlled probe; a system-only path, directory variables and disabled analysis caching did not. The exact internal PowerShell routine was not instrumented.
windows_ci_startup.correction: Use an empty PSModulePath, explicitly import the required Windows system modules, close stdin, emit UTF-8 and keep the 5000ms limit. No user module path or coordinator credential is inherited by the query.

cold_initialization_followup.observation: The first three identity queries timed out during cold startup; subsequent queries and the remaining process fixtures passed with empty module discovery. That intermediate result did not complete Windows CI validation.
cold_initialization_followup.correction: Prepare the OS query runtime once before registry locks or launch reservations, using a read-only self-query and an exact acknowledgement. A persistent service host establishes its native job before preparing its own query helper. Failed initialization refuses startup; steady identity queries retain their original limit.

windows_ci_startup.scope: These probes only inspect local processes and print phase markers. Their eight-case matrices are diagnostic observations, not extra automated test counts or real-model evidence.

rpc_shutdown.observed_error: Failed to bind sockets: Address already in use (os error 98)
rpc_shutdown.local_followup: A stricter test reproduced an occupied stage UDP address immediately after close returned, even after an intermediate change drained the owned task sets.
rpc_shutdown.observed_local_error: stage UDP port retained after close (os error 10048)
rpc_shutdown.correction: Drain owned listener tasks, drop the endpoint reference, then observe actual UDP address release within 3000ms. Return an error if another reference or owner retains it. Fixture port selection also avoids reusing a probed number within the concurrent suite, and bind phases are named in errors.
rpc_shutdown.scope: Source-library lifecycle validation, including the hosted Linux Rust suite. Existing model-route transport binaries and their pins remain unchanged; the 32B campaign does not prove a rebuilt transport executable.
